_instructions: Template for DEDUCTIVE mode. Copy this file to the path set in harmonization.deductive_codebook (default: codebook_deductive.json), replace the placeholders, and set harmonization.codebook_mode to 'deductive'. Every theme of the config needs at least one sub-theme (there is no 'Other' category). 'id' and 'example_codes' are optional: ids are generated from the theme name if omitted.

STORYTELLING.name: <Sub-theme name>
STORYTELLING.definition: <What this sub-theme includes, precise enough for another coder to apply it>
